# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.8.1

Version 1.8.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.8.0

**Held upright, the far side is drawn.** In v1.8.0's portrait layout the top of the screen sees far north, nearly to
the horizon, where the game draws nothing (it only ever shows the ground of the nine acres around the player and the
trees and items of the four nearest): black showed there, mostly when standing near the north edge of an acre. Now the
ground of every acre in view is drawn, with its trees, flowers and items, and the far plane is moved out. The
buildings and villagers of acres two or more away are still not shown (they are not in the game at that distance).

**Full touch: a tap means a thing before the ground.**
- **With the shovel**, the ground it works on comes first: a crack where something is buried (a fossil, ...), a
  shining spot, a hole, found near the finger even when a tree or a villager stands in front of it on the screen.
  Until now a tree there took the tap, and a tap on a crack itself tried to pick up what is buried (nothing happened).
- A tap just beside an item, a sign, a mailbox or a villager, or on the top of an item's picture, uses it instead of
  walking there. Flowers, and trees with the axe in hand, still only where tapped (a pick or a chop cannot be taken
  back); beside a tree, only close to it, so walking among trees stays easy.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.8.0's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Played by script with touches, on a 720x1560 window (a phone's shape) and on 1280x720:

- **Far**: at the north edges of acres where v1.8.0 showed black at the top, the far ground, a bridge, trees and fences
  are drawn; elsewhere the picture is as before.
- **The shovel**: a fossil buried right behind a tree (on the screen the tree in front of it) and a tap on its crack:
  the player went to the crack and dug it (the unit became a hole). The same tap on v1.8.0 went to a tree in front of
  it.
- **Near**: a tap a unit beside an apple on the ground, and one on the top of its picture, picked it up (v1.8.0 walked
  there). After a talk, a tap in the open beside a tree walked, as before.
- Portrait as in v1.8.0: the talk's answer buttons, the pockets' drag, the furniture mode.
- Landscape: of the fifteen touch checks run on v1.7.0's release and on this version, thirteen log the same and give the
  same screenshots; in one a tap just above the notice board's roof now goes to the board instead of walking, in the
  other a shovel's tap on a hole is logged as digging instead of using (the same press and the same screenshots).
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.7.0 and
  on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` and `PC_ENHANCEMENTS` only and the matching build's
  hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.8.1, versionCode 10801); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.8.0's.

## Known limitations

- Held upright, the buildings and villagers of acres two or more away are not shown.
- The upright layout was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone.
- The limitations of v1.8.0 remain (see the [v1.8.0 notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.8.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
